title: Act: Implement YAML loader and reference validator
description: Implement loader and validator using the types from backend/game/src/state/types.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Given content, when loaded, then typed objects are returned.
Given bad references, when validated, then errors are listed.

steps.action: Export loadWorld(worldDir:string):{world:WorldDef;scenes:Record<string,SceneDef>}; read join(worldDir,'world.yaml') then for each id in world.scenes read join(worldDir,'scenes',id+'.yaml'); wrap readFileSync/parse in try/catch rethrowing Error(`Failed to load ${path}: ${message}`).
steps.expected: Returns both objects for valid dirs; throws naming the file otherwise.

steps.action: Export validateWorld(world,scenes):string[]; push errors: `unknown scene: X` for world.startScene or goto_scene not in scenes; `unknown character: X` for say.character or dialogue speaker not in world.characters (or 'narrator'); `unknown object: X` for discover.object not in the scene objects; `unknown flag: X` for set_flag/condition flags not in world.flags. Walk every scene object action events, conditions, openWhenFlag and dialogue choice events and next ids (`unknown dialogue node: X`).
steps.expected: Empty array for valid content; one message per bad reference.
